name: Siouan
notes: Siouan (Siouan-Catawban) — a classification node, not a language. It groups its descendants (including the Dakotan languages Dakota and Lakota) and carries no phonology of its own: a clade is a set, not something anyone spoke. Glottolog languoid siou1252 (family level).

sources.author: Hammarström, Harald et al.
